blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Friday gave Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who has been in hiding following the issuance of an International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant, one week to surrender. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. issued the ultimatum after the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) earlier placed a P50 million bounty for the senator’s arrest. READ: P50-M bounty for capture of armed and dangerous Bato Dela Rosa – DILG “Sen.
